summary: Eruption continuing with increased seismicity; Alert Level raised to 3 (of 0–5) on 8 October and exclusion zones modified.
Single brief explosion on 1 October; alert raised to Advisory/Yellow, lowered back to Normal/Green on 6 October.
Increased volcanic earthquakes beneath the summit crater since late September.
Continuing eruptive activity during 1–7 October, with white plumes and recorded eruptive events.
Ash plumes to 1.8–2.1 km a.s.l. on 3 and 5–7 October.
Eruptive events on 1 and 4 October; seismicity increased during the week.
New lava flow first visible on 29 September; seismicity intensified from 27 September.
Ash plume on 30 September and frequent ash emissions on 1 October.
Ongoing activity at Sakurajima's Minamidake Crater; slightly high sulfur dioxide emissions.
No further unrest after explosions on 20 September; Aviation Color Code lowered to Green on 5 October.
Gas emissions and periodic minor ash emissions at Northeast Crater.
Slow lava effusion feeding a thick flow in the summit crater.

Eruption continuing at North Crater; white plumes to 200 m.
Summit eruption with spatter and lava flows continuing at variable levels.
